name: creator-os
description: Local-first OBS overlay system with YouTube API integration, WebSocket events, glassmorphism themes, admin controls, and multi-overlay support.
author: VikeshCodes

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend && npm run check:admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:admin
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:admin
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:admin
